What's new in DuckOS 1.0.105

• DuckOS lock screen: its own big clock, the date, the weather, battery and next alarm, what's playing, and your latest notifications in glass, with the flashlight and the camera at hand. Waking up, it comes out of the dark into focus and DuckOS's ring draws itself. Swipe up and it blurs away to your face, fingerprint or PIN. Once you're in, the home screen comes into focus. You can turn it off in Settings › Lock screen.
• DuckMessage: new messages spring in, and the ones you send spring up from where you typed them. The conversation no longer flickers when a message arrives, and when the keyboard opens, the newest messages stay in sight.
• Removing an app asks only once, in DuckOS's own sheet.
• DuckWallet cards in DuckCloud, end-to-end encrypted, now also without a passwords password (the "DuckWallet cards" switch in DuckCloud).
